tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Find APIs on dataandapis.com by the data they provide (e.g. 'sanctions screening', 'barcode nutrition', 'IP geolocation', 'company by domain', 'public holidays'). Returns up to 10 matches with slug, one-line summary, base URL and docs. Follow with get_api for the endpoints.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Full reference for one API: every endpoint with method, path, path and query parameters with example values, request body and an example response, plus the token cost per call. Use the slug from search_apis.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Make a live request to a dataandapis.com API with the user's API key (sent as X-Api-Key on this MCP connection). Give the API slug, the endpoint path from get_api (path parameters already filled in, e.g. '/v1/products/3017620422003'), optional query parameters and, for POST, a JSON body. Most calls

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_apis · Private data: get_api, call_api · Public sink: call_api.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_apis · Private data: get_api, call_api · Public sink: call_api

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
